content.comment_body: Hello, I created a small program using [product_name] and configured a message to display as a ticker, character by character. When I start [product_name], the text initially scrolls to the left as expected, but after three cycles it begins scrolling right, which is confusing. With an older [product_name] unit and software version, the message always scrolled left. Is this normal behavior? I don't think so. I used [product_name] programming software [version_no]. The hardware was [product_name] ([article_no], [version_no], 24 vac/dc). Update: I tested with a different [product_name] ([article_no], [version_no], 230 vac) and the ticker works correctly.
I don’t have that particular hardware version for [product_name]. Currently, I have the newer [product_name] ([article_no], 12/24RCE), and the ticker works as expected there.

Hello [user_name], thank you. It seems the issue is with the [version_no] hardware, since other units like [version_no] (using [product_name] programming software [version_no]) work correctly. If no one responds by Monday, I'll contact [company_name]'s support and share updates.
Alternatively, you could submit a support request.

Hello, I submitted a support request on Saturday, and today received a response. Support was unable to resolve the issue directly. They recommended downloading the program using an earlier software version to test, but I mentioned that different hardware ([version_no]) works correctly. They will escalate the issue to [company_name] in Germany to determine if it’s hardware-related. I’ll keep everyone updated.

Hello, Update from technical support in Germany: Thank you for the video demonstration. It does indeed show the ticker moving in the wrong direction. I tested with the same hardware version ([article_no], [version_no]) and used the current [product_name] programming software. Only [version_no] and [version_no] are compatible with your hardware. Please make sure the configuration matches your hardware version ([version_no]). I have used various [product_name] versions and the ticker always behaved consistently. Since there isn’t a parameter to set the direction, I am unable to explain this and can only suggest replacing the hardware. Best regards, Your Technical Support for Industry Automation and Drive Technologies They have advised me to change the hardware, but I will continue testing.

analysis.insight_summary: Users observe the ticker feature on [product_name] ([version_no], particularly [version_no] hardware) reverses scrolling after a few cycles, unlike previous hardware versions where it moved consistently in one direction. Multiple users and support confirm that the issue is specific to the [version_no] variant, suggesting a hardware-related anomaly since there is no software setting to control scrolling direction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ticker message to scroll in a single, consistent direction as it did on previous hardware or software versions, without unexpected changes in behavior.
